text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - 30% of requests for customer AcmePayments are returning 500 / schema-mismatch since 12:02 UTC. Tag: routing=fallback. Escalation: oncall.

erin_oncall: on it. seeing increased error rate on /v1/chat/completions from edge-us-east-1. symptoms look like 'incompatible-variant' errors in logs. pulling traces.

tyler_sre: confirm — logs show fallback to model variant 'gptx-1-instruct' for chat routes. That's the wrong variant, chat clients expect chat-schema with assistant/persona tokens. We rolled a policy yesterday that pins some routes to v2 for cost testing.

maria_ml: who deployed the policy? I pushed a bulk routing change to reduce costs for non-critical customers. Looks like the policy matched AcmePayment's route due to an old tag on their account. Oof.

alex_prod: customer impact: AcmePayments reported payment UI errors. Their session logs show model responses missing required 'assistant' wrapper and embedding endpoints returning text blobs. They think it's our API outage. Lina, please triage with them.

lina_support: pinged customer, provided incident page. They're seeing payment retries and timeouts; business-critical. They're asking for ETA and mitigation. Set to high priority.

erin_oncall: mitigation plan: (1) stop fallback policy match for AcmePayment (2) unpin to correct chat variant or force rollback of the routing policy (3) run a canary to verify. I'm going to patch routing rule now.

tyler_sre: suggest quick mitigation: override routing rule to route AcmePayments to 'gptx-1-chat' explicitly. Then revert the cost policy later. Command:
```
# emergency override
rwctl routing set --customer acme-payments --model gptx-1-chat --reason "emergency incompatible-variant fallback"
```

erin_oncall: executing override now.

ops-bot: Executing job rwctl-override-1793248123 by erin_oncall...

ops-bot: SUCCESS: routing override applied. New route id r-8f3d. Traffic should flow to gptx-1-chat. (rollout: 100% immediate)

erin_oncall: monitoring logs and traces... error rate dropping.

maria_ml: confirming model compatibility checks. We should also add a guard to routing engine to reject variant switches across interface types (chat <> instruct <> embed). I'll open a follow-up ticket.

alex_prod: notifying customers team and CS. Lina, please escalate to AcmePayments exec contact and let them know we've applied fix and are monitoring.

lina_support: sent update: "We've applied an override forcing chat model variant; you should see traffic recover in <5 min>. We're monitoring and will follow up." They acknowledged.

tyler_sre: root cause: routing policy matching logic used a shared label 'cost-tier:low' that matched AcmePayments because their project tag was stale. Combined with a permissive fallback list that allowed cross-interface variants, the router selected instruct variant for chat requests. Repro steps attached below.

tyler_sre: repro (dev):
```
# simplified policy that caused match
match:
  - tag: cost-tier:low
fallback:
  - gptx-1-instruct
  - gptx-1-embed
```

tyler_sre: immediate remediation checklist:
- [x] override route -> gptx-1-chat (done)
- [x] block cross-interface fallbacks in routing engine (temp rule)
- [ ] roll back yesterday's bulk policy (in progress)
- [ ] add automated tests to detect interface mismatches on fallback

erin_oncall: I'm going to hand off to tyler for post-mitigation follow-ups. TY: take the incident to resolution and run RCA.

tyler_sre: taking handoff. I'll coordinate with maria_ml for the guard fix and with infra to revert bulk policy. Also will patch policy service to fail-safe on interface mismatch.

maria_ml: ETA for guard patch: 6 hours for code + tests, can push hotfix to routing service in ~3 hours if we prioritize.

alex_prod: Customer impact note for postmortem: AcmePayments had ~12 minutes of degraded responses starting 12:02 UTC; ~2.4k failed requests, payment retries triggered. No data exfiltration. Severity: P1 until resolved. Action: CS follow-up and credits offered.

lina_support: collecting exact request ids and customer logs for the billing and SRE teams. Will attach to the incident page.

ops-bot: deploy bot: rollout of routing-service v3.4.1 started at 12:40 UTC (this contains unrelated optimizations). No changes to routing logic yet.

tyler_sre: note: make sure the audit trail includes who applied the bulk policy change. maria, can you link the PR?

maria_ml: PR #1983 — "costing: bulk route tag updates". I pushed it yesterday. I'll add annotation and revert commits.

erin_oncall: final status: override applied; error rates back to baseline as of 12:15 UTC. handing to tyler for RCA and follow-ups. Incident closed for oncall.

tyler_sre: Will file full RCA and mitigation plan: (1) add interface type guards to routing engine, (2) add policy-application dry-run to prevent mass-matching unintended customers, (3) add a quick-check webhook that rejects fallbacks where model.interface != request.interface. Also add regression tests in infra-e2e. Expect RCA draft in ~4 hours.

maria_ml: adding follow-up TODO: tag hygiene sweep for customers with manual tags.

lina_support: customer update posted. They'll wait for RCA. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by erin_oncall -> handed to tyler_sre for RCA.
